name: Gesamtsystem-Audit

ARCHITECTURE.assessment: Selection, Timing, Probability, Risk, Confidence, Learning, Elliott, Decision and External Evidence remain semantically separated; External Evidence remains quarantined from the canonical Decision path.

INFORMATION_FLOW.assessment: Material post-7D Action parents are explicit after BA-QM11-F01 CAPA; W6 upstream lineage remains explicitly incomplete rather than being treated as independent.

DECISION_LOGIC.assessment: Review actions are deterministically derived from preserved Universal Stance, transition, explicit position context and typed review contexts; no order execution is enabled.

UNCERTAINTY.assessment: Conflict, insufficient evidence, pending confirmation and provisional reliability remain visible; reliability is not converted into a numeric success probability.

MISSINGNESS.assessment: Missing Decision evidence fails closed; blocked states remain blocked and cannot be replaced by legacy scanner heuristics or neutralized.

FALSIFIABILITY.assessment: QM-J can and did trigger a promotion stop; the Lag-1 control remains unresolved by engineering success.

LEARNING.assessment: Outcome-driven W8 learning is now explicitly separated from independent validation and requires post-change prospective evidence.

OPERATIONALIZATION.assessment: Depot Watch remains a same-snapshot presentation of the Decision chain; BA-QM9/10 fail-closed and production controls remain authoritative.

PURPOSE_FIDELITY.assessment: The system still prioritizes securities or existing positions for closer review and explains why; it does not convert the scanner into automatic execution.

findings.title: Material post-7D Action parents were incomplete in QM-I lineage
findings.root_cause: QM-I Phase-7 action registration predated the later W6 and W7/W8 material review-context integrations and still represented Portfolio Action with only 7D Decision and Position Snapshot parents.
findings.evidence_disposition: No empirical promotion had occurred. Existing actions are not declared false. Future ancestry/independence review must use the corrected graph; incomplete W6 upstream lineage may not be interpreted as independence.

findings.title: Outcome-driven W8 policy was outside the original 7I freeze
findings.root_cause: The 7I protocol was frozen on 2026-09-25, while W8/Ferrari F1-F4 was introduced on 2026-10-01 after inspection of the source case and can change the final 7F review state.
findings.evidence_disposition: W8 remains research-only and empirically unvalidated. Ferrari/RACE is regression evidence only; W8 promotion review requires post-2026-10-01 prospective-unspent shadow evidence.

residual_risks: W6 Elliott immediate action ancestry is now explicit, but its upstream Elliott-to-raw-data lineage is marked incomplete and must not be treated as proof of independence.
W8 empirical utility is unknown until prospective-unspent post-change evidence matures.
The independent Phase-1A Lag-1 promotion block remains active.
Phase-8 External Evidence remains intentionally outside the canonical Decision path until separately promoted.
